column2: The united council must decide how to meet the governments beyond its boundaries. Some burghers call for common districts under one legislature. Others propose treaties that bind neighbouring councils to the union while preserving their local authority. Republican delegates favour accession to the Volksraad, while the ducal ministers can build a wider association under the constitutional crown. The charter will guide our envoys and the terms they present.
Seek accession to our common legislature.
Build an association of protected councils.

The unity achieved at Winburg gives the government influence beyond the Vaal, but neighbouring councils have their own land titles, political obligations and claims to independence. An accession programme would seek to bring districts under the common legislature. An association of protectorates would extend the union's diplomatic authority while retaining local rulers and assemblies. The ministers ask the council to choose a guiding policy before paying for missions and frontier expeditions. Neither charter itself transfers land or compels another government to agree.
